commit.message:
v3.9.0 (#901)

* docs: Document commits from master (v3.8.5..HEAD) in NEWS.md v3.9.0

Added missing commits from master to v3.9.0 release notes:
- New functions: occ_term, occ_download_countries, occ_download_user_count, occ_download_organizations
- API coverage improvements: Added missing parameters to dataset_*, occ_*, institution_*, collection_*, and organizations functions
- checklistKey parameter support for occ_download at root and predicate levels
- Bug fixes: ORCID/ROR syntax and deleted taxon key replacement

* chore: Bump version to 3.9.0

* REVDEPCHECK: Run reverse dependency checks for v3.9.0

* fresh fixtures

* fix: Address winbuilder NOTEs

- Fix 404 URL: Change techdocs.gbif.org/en/openapi/v2/species to v1
- Fix deprecated .Names: Change to names in structure() call in gbif_issues.R
- Rebuild documentation for gbif_to_col.Rd

* fix: Change ROR format in DESCRIPTION to avoid Author field NOTE

Changed rOpenSci ROR from named comment to plain URL string to match R auto-generated Author field formatting
